Read placeholders information from PowerPoint presentation

Source: R/layout.R
read_slide_placeholders.Rd

Read placeholders information from PowerPoint presentation

read_slide_placeholders(
  pptx,
  index,
  only_slide = FALSE,
  only_layout = FALSE,
  keep_all = FALSE,
  error_call = current_env()
)

Arguments

pptx

A PowerPoint wrapped in a <pptx_container> object. see load_pptx()

index

slide index

only_slide

if TRUE only extract placeholders from the slide, i.e. not from its associated layout

only_layout

if TRUE only extract placeholders from the layout, i.e. not occupied in the slide

keep_all

if FALSE, only keep non missing placeholders

error_call

The execution environment of a currently running function, e.g. caller_env(). The function will be mentioned in error messages as the source of the error. See the call argument of abort() for more information.

Value

A tibble with columns describing the placeholders:

slide_index

numeric; slide index

slide_file

character; basename of the slide file

layout_file

character; basename of the layout file

layout_name

character; name of the layout

id

character; placeholder id

offx

numeric; x offset in inches

offy

numeric; y offset in inches

cx

numeric; width in inches

cy

numeric; height in inches

ph_type

character; placeholder type

ph

character; placeholder XML node as glue object

ph_id

character; placeholder idx attribute

slide_ph_name

character; placeholder name from slide

slide_ph_id

character; placeholder id from slide

layout_ph_name

character; placeholder name from layout

metadata

list; metadata extracted from placeholder

The tibble has a dimensions attribute containing the slide size.

Examples

ppt <- example_pptx()
read_slide_placeholders(ppt)
#> # A tibble: 19 × 16
#>    slide_index slide_file layout_file  layout_name id     offx  offy    cx    cy
#>          <dbl> <chr>      <chr>        <chr>       <chr> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
